semantics.note: The paraphrase roughly tracks the words. But 'everything else' and 'glommed on top' are loose rhetorical terms: there is no defined capability set or reliability threshold.

contract.note: The contract counts only external components as 'glommed on top' and excludes anything learned inside the model. In context, Marcus's band-aids based on human corrections plausibly include training-time fixes. The result depends on this reading, which the speaker did not supply and which is stretched against him. The 2025 target period is also imposed.

evidence.note: A 2025 Anthropic company disclosure of internal rhyme planning. It contradicts only under the contract's narrow 'external-only' reading, and it does not show the capability goes beyond word correlation as Marcus means it.
Web search is an added tool. Consistent with the narrow point, but it does not settle the broad claim or reliability.

reviews.rationale: This is a loose architectural characterisation with no defined scope or reliability measure. The contract's contradiction rests on excluding learned or trained additions, but Marcus's own context about human-correction band-aids suggests he includes them. Scoring the claim against internal-planning evidence would hold him to a reading he did not supply, so it is not adjudicable on fair terms.

contract.note: Fabrication is read as a false denial without intent, and 'on its own' as without tools. Both are ordinary readings faithful to the words.

CBS confirms Maduro was captured on Saturday, January 3, so the denial was false. The locator cites early-morning entries before the test.

reviews.rationale: WIRED records ChatGPT denying the capture, and CBS confirms the capture happened that day, with reporting before the test. That makes the denial false. Reaching live news sites requires an external tool beyond the bare model, as OpenAI's own description indicates. Both parts hold.

There is no model set, task set, or threshold. It is too vague to score as a whole without changing what Marcus said.
